about: Shared by `cargo test` (src/patch_tests.rs) and by `node --test` (patches.test.js): the same cases, the first through Rust, the second through the embedded WebAssembly. A case is a call of apply_patches on `workspace` with `plateau` and `patches`; it expects either `error` (the exact sentence; or `error_contains`, pieces of it, where a library writes part of the sentence) and `error_patch`, or the `workspace` that results (the base with `edits` applied in order: `set` and `append` and `remove` at a JSON pointer) and the `reports` (the `patches` of the answer, exactly).
